raw_text:
name: dotnet-upgrade
description: Comprehensive .NET upgrade analysis/execution prompts
Prompts:
- Classify solution projects (`.NET Framework`, `.NET Core`, `.NET Standard`); analyze `.csproj` `TargetFramework`/SDK.
- Review dependency compatibility/complexity, `packages.config`→`PackageReference`, NuGet/transitive conflicts and migration paths.
- Order least-to-most dependent; isolate class libraries before API/Azure Function migrations; plan rollback checkpoints and **Upgrade Assistant** or **manual upgrades**.
- Select/update `TargetFramework` (e.g., `net8.0`), SDK/build config; modernize `WebHostBuilder` → `HostBuilder`, APIs, synchronous calls, libraries.
- Analyze YAML; update `UseDotNet@2`, `NuGetToolInstaller`; generate .NET 8 pipelines, CI, feature-branch validation, build/unit/integration tests, service/backward-compatibility/UAT/production checks.
- Detect APIs with `.NET Upgrade Assistant` and API Analyzer; refactor `Startup.cs` → `Program.cs`; regression plans.
- Provide branching/rollback, commit/PR (`Upgrade to .NET [Version]`), breaking-change tags, review/documentation/release-note/stakeholder/dashboard/checklist templates.
- Use `.NET Upgrade Assistant`, `dotnet list package --outdated`, `dotnet migrate`, and `graph.json` dependency visualization.
- Generate dependency scripts, Copilot prompts, multi-repository workflows, final validation, artifacts, completion/deployment checklists, and release documentation.
